rationale: Focused in vivo survival CRISPR screen (Kim et al. 2024, Cell): H9 hPSC-derived dopamine neurons carrying a doxycycline-inducible Cas9 and a 538-guide 'large pool' library (about 160 cell-death / survival genes with 3 guides each, 50 non-targeting and 50 safe-harbor controls). After Dox-induced editing, the day-25 edited pool was kept in vitro (D25 Dox+) or grafted into mouse striatum (D25 Graft Dox+). Guides enriched in the graft mark genes whose knockout improves neuron survival in vivo (the paper's finding: loss of TP53-mediated apoptosis and TNF-NF-kB signalling, e.g. TP53, BBC3/PUMA). Each GEO sheet has two count columns that are technical re-reads of one library (correlation > 0.998, constant ratio), summed by prepare.R, so there is one library per condition and run_barcs.R uses the no-replicate path (screening-level calls) pooling overdispersion over the 100 control guides.
